name: Rejection Reason 62 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the transaction or in the instruction has a rejected status.

REFE.name: Reference Rejection
REFE.definition: Instruction has a reference identical to another previously received instruction.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Transaction/instruction received after the account servicer's specified deadline.

CCIX.name: Client Collateral Instruction Identification
CCIX.definition: Unrecognised or invalid client collateral instruction identification.

CCTI.name: Client Collateral Transaction Identification
CCTI.definition: Unrecognised or invalid Client Collateral Transaction Identification.

IIND.name: Common Reference Rejection
IIND.definition: Unrecognised, invalid or missing common reference.

SAFA.name: Party A Safekeeping Account
SAFA.definition: Unrecognised or invalid Party A Safekeeping Account

SAFB.name: Party B Safekeeping Account
SAFB.definition: Unrecognised or Invalid Party B Safekeeping Account.

SEPR.name: Settlement Process Rejection
SEPR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement process instructed.

LBDR.name: Lookback Days Rejection
LBDR.definition: Number of lookback days not supported.

CSAC.name: Compound Simple Accrual Calculation Rejection
CSAC.definition: Compound simple accrual calculation is not supported.

DTRD.name: Trade Date
DTRD.definition: Unrecognised or invalid trade date or requested trade date or future trade date.

NCRR.name: Settlement Amount Currency Rejection
NCRR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement amount currency.

IESP.name: Invalid Eligibility Set Profile
IESP.definition: This is an unrecognised or invalid Eligibility Set Profile.

IEXT.name: Invalid Exposure Type
IEXT.definition: This is an unrecognised or invalid Exposure Type (used when a proprietary code is sent).

IPBI.name: Invalid Preferential Basket Identification
IPBI.definition: Unrecognised or invalid Preferential Basket identification.

IRIT.name: Invalid Rate Index Type
IRIT.definition: Unrecognised or invalid Rate Index Type (used when a proprietary code is sent).

REPA.name: Termination Transaction Amount
REPA.definition: Unrecognised or invalid termination transaction amount.

NRGM.name: No Match
NRGM.definition: More than one instruction match the criteria.

TABC.name: Transaction Amount Breakdown Currency
TABC.definition: Transaction amount breakdown currency differs from transaction amount currency.

ICTT.name: Invalid Collateral Transaction Type
ICTT.definition: This is an unrecognised or invalid Collateral Transaction Type.

NRJN.name: Not Found Rejection For Cancellation Modification Or Termination
NRJN.definition: Cancellation, modification or termination request has been rejected since the instruction could not be found.

NFCA.name: Not Found Corresponding Allegement
NFCA.definition: Instruction has been rejected as the corresponding allegement was cancelled.

CTRA.name: Closing Transaction Amount
CTRA.definition: Unrecognised or invalid closing closing amount.
